description.summary: This haunting ensemble disrupts the natural flow of magic in hostile casters.
description.value: This haunting ensemble disrupts the natural flow of magic in hostile casters. Enemies attempting to cast spells within 30 feet of you must attempt a will save. On a failure, the time required to cast their spells increases by 1 step (a swift action becomes a move action , a move action becomes a standard action , a standard action become a full-round action , a full-round action becomes a 1 turn cast spell, and 1 turn cast spells become 2 turn cast spells). Affected casters may choose whether or not to pay the increased action cost; if not, they lose the original action and the associated spell. Additionally, enemies receive a -4 penalty on concentration checks and caster level checks to overcome spell resistance while they remain within this song’s area of effect (no save). This spell was submitted as a part of the SCC for December 2020 by MagnusXL.
